notes.title: ”and Roger” Advance Player Interview
notes.notes: [p]“It felt like love.” [/p][p]”It made for a very unique and immersive experience.”[/p][p] “I ended up crying more than I expected.”[/p][p] “something you can’t get from books, movies, or videos—just something only a game can do—then this is the one to play.” [/p][p][/p][p]Each of the four interviewees talks about “and Roger” in their own words.[/p][p] Interviewees: Osakana, Junto, Nerigoma, Hayu [/p][p]Cinematography, Editing, and Music: Yasuhiro Nakashima [/p][p][/p][p]*The participants in this video are members of the general public who applied for the monitor recruitment conducted in June 2025.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_Ox49RiFDpc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: "and Roger" Launches Today!
notes.notes: [p]Kodansha Game Creators Lab has officially launched the interactive novel "DareKare" today, July 24, 2025 (Thursday).[/p][p][/p][p]This title has already garnered international attention even before its release, having been selected as a finalist in the "Best Simulation Game" category at China's game award, "GAME CONNECTION x CHINAJOY 2025 INDIE GAME AWARDS."[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate its launch, a special launch sale is currently underway on Steam. For a limited time until August 6 (Wednesday), the game is available at a discounted price of ¥480 (tax included), which is 20% off its regular price of ¥600 (tax included). Don't miss this opportunity to purchase the game![/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, we have prepared a kit for those who wish to stream or post videos of this title. Please download and use it from the link below![/p][p][url="https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/opi1vcws0g1lpox8o3pcc/AMwP9Kzic807jbZRjiPvQzk?rlkey=mivibiyviy9ynjgqtmvzy0i3x&st=xiel83c4&dl=0"]https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/opi1vcws0g1lpox8o3pcc/AMwP9Kzic807jbZRjiPvQzk?rlkey=mivibiyviy9ynjgqtmvzy0i3x&st=xiel83c4&dl=0[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The release date for “and Roger” has been set for July 24, 2025!
notes.notes: [p]The release date of [b]and Roger[/b] has been set for July 24, 2025! [/p][p]To commemorate this, we've released an interview video "and Roger behind the scenes - yona edition" with creator yona, who worked on its production. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="JFP0yfKmWis;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]"Why did I decide to make this game?"[/p][p] "What were the particularities in the expression of art and story?"[/p][p] "What is necessary for indie games?"[/p][p][/p][p] This interview video features yona himself discussing the background of the production and his thoughts on this work. Please take a look![/p]
